subject: True-up proposal for September spike and renewal amendment
messages:
From: Ari Walsh <ari.walsh@cleverpay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected usage spike — need help with invoice

Hi Karthik,

Quick note — our finance team just pulled the September usage numbers and we saw a 3x spike in inference hours between Sep 3–7 due to an internal pilot that accidentally routed production traffic to the new model. We completed our renewal with Redwood yesterday but the spike pushes us over our committed monthly hours and looks like it'll show up as a large one-off overage on the upcoming invoice.

Can you advise how Redwood typically handles these true-ups for customers who are in the middle of a renewal? We're open to:
- absorbing a one-time overage and paying it in full, or
- amortizing the charge across the remaining months of the renewal, or
- increasing committed capacity for the remainder of the term and applying a credit.

We need an approach we can present to our CFO today — can you propose a concrete option and a ballpark number?

Appreciate the help.

Thanks,
Ari Walsh
Head of Infrastructure
CleverPay
ari.walsh@cleverpay.com
+1 415-555-0127
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Walsh <ari.walsh@cleverpay.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-10T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected usage spike — need help with invoice

Thanks for flagging, Ari — sorry to hear about the routing issue. We're happy to make this straightforward. Two practical options we see working given similar cases:

1) One-time settlement: invoice the overage as a one-time charge for the excess inference hours at the overage rate. We can offer a 10% good-faith discount for the accidental pilot and issue a single invoice due net 30.

2) Amortized true-up + commit adjustment: convert the overage into a one-time amount and amortize it over the remaining term months (you pick 3–6 months). In addition we can increase your committed tier for the remainder of the term (reducing future unit costs) so the incremental cashflow is smoother.

To give you a ballpark we need the raw usage export for Sep 1–10 (or Sep 1–30 if available). Laura and Monica, could you run the export and prepare a quick proposed invoice?

If you prefer we can draft both a one-time invoice and an amortized schedule so your CFO can compare. If you confirm approach today we'll prepare a DocuSign amendment / PO-ready invoice.

Which would you prefer — single invoice with discount, or amortized schedule with commit bump?

Best,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-11T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected usage spike — need help with invoice (internal)

Laura / Ben — Ari from CleverPay hit a 3x spike early Sep due to a routing error. They renewed yesterday; spike will appear as overage on the upcoming invoice. Ari asked for options this morning.

Can you run a quick delta calc: committed hours for Sep vs actual hours Sep 1–10 (and extrapolate if they provide full-month data). We need:
- total excess inference hours
- unit overage rate per hour (their current plan)
- suggested 10% goodwill discount on one-time invoice
- amortization schedule if we split over 6 months (show monthly amortized amount)

If you have a model for offering a small promo credit when customers increase commit mid-term, include that too (e.g., waive first month of increased commit). Aim to turn around a proposed invoice PDF and a CSV usage export.

Thanks — need numbers by today EOD to give Ari finance a recommendation.

Karthik
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Ari Walsh <ari.walsh@cleverpay.com>
Date: 2026-09-11T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected usage spike — draft numbers and attachments

Karthik / Ben / Ari — attaching the usage extract and a draft invoice for review. Summary below.

Summary (Sep 1–10 measured):
- Committed hours (monthly): 150,000 inference-hours
- Actual observed (Sep 1–10 extrapolated to month): 210,500 inference-hours (pilot caused 60,500 excess)
- Overage rate: $0.30 / inference-hour
- Raw overage: 60,500 * $0.30 = $18,150
- Good-faith discount (10%): -$1,815
- One-time invoice total: $16,335

Amortization option (6 months):
- Net amortized amount: $16,335 / 6 = $2,722.50 per month
- Suggested commit bump (optionally): move from 150k to 225k for remaining 9 months, first month of bumped commit waived as promo if accepted.

Attachments: 
- Sept_usage_report.csv (CSV extract: daily hours, peaks, matched request ids)
- proposed_invoice_CLEV-2026-09.pdf (PDF pro forma invoice showing one-time and amortized lines, PO field left blank)

If Ari wants both paperwork options we'll prepare a DocuSign amendment for the amortized path (includes commit change) and a standalone invoice for the one-time charge.

Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
From: Ari Walsh <ari.walsh@cleverpay.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, finance@cleverpay.com
Date: 2026-09-17T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected usage spike — need help with invoice (acceptance)

Thanks everyone — that calc looks right and is very helpful. We’ll proceed with the amortized path. Confirming:

- We accept the $16,335 net true-up amortized over 6 months ($2,722.50/mo)
- We accept increasing commit from 150k -> 225k inference-hours for the remainder of the term (9 months left) with first month of the bumped commit waived as agreed
- PO: PO-88721 (attaching internally)

Please send the DocuSign amendment for the commit change and the amortization schedule so our procurement team can sign. HubSpot deal ID is 98765 if you need to tie paperwork to the renewal.

DocuSign link (generated): https://app.docusign.com/tenant/abcdef123456

Appreciate the quick turnaround — copying finance@cleverpay.com to confirm they'll route the PO once DocuSign is in place.

Best,
Ari
